caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench with two seat spaces, four legs, and two armrests. The bench is constructed of wood with a visibly worn texture, and the color is predominantly brown with areas showing shades of red, yellow, and hints of blue or green, especially on the upper section. The backrest features carved decorative patterns, including repeating shapes filled with yellow and reddish tones. The arms of the bench are curved, and the legs are turned and joined by horizontal supports. The bench is shown against a plain, light beige or tan background with no other objects or elements present in the composition. There are no shadows on the background, and the bench appears to be floating or isolated on the blank space.
title: Child's Settee
